## PROBLEM
Final security audit unitAI-bw5d7 found .github/workflows/telemetry-contract.yml uses actions/checkout@v6 and oven-sh/setup-bun@v2 while sibling workflows SHA-pin actions. Tag movement is a supply-chain consistency gap.

## SUCCESS
Both telemetry-contract actions use reviewed 40-hex commit SHAs, lockstep/version comments remain accurate, and workflow/tests pass.

## SCOPE
.github/workflows/telemetry-contract.yml and the smallest focused workflow assertion if one exists.

## NON_GOALS
No release-attestation, runtime, dependency, publication, tag, credential, runner, or other workflow changes.

## VALIDATION
Sweep telemetry-contract uses refs; run focused workflow tests and diff check. Security review confirms no remaining non-immutable refs in this workflow.

## OUTPUT
Commit/PR and exact pinned SHAs with provenance.
